sources.observed_match_data: FotMob final scores, expected goals, team stats, and declared lineups

evidence_findings: The frozen XI averaged 9.15/11 starters; selection error still reaches Player Alpha before kickoff.
Observed match xG totals spanned 1.36-6.83, while the base forecast spanned only 2.71-3.14; the goal environment is over-compressed in this sample.
Only 3/5 route families became preferred; missing direct_transition, wide_delivery.
The pre-kickoff applied conservative goal coefficient still has the best side-xG MAE among the artifact's frozen choices (applied_conservative); increasing sensitivity is not the fix.
audit_read.next_iteration: Audit the route and lineup assumptions behind structural misses; do not refit the context coefficient on this partial sample.
